title: Fallback spraymap + burn-rate check (quick sheet)
content:
Purpose:
Quick, cross-functional snapshot to map which public API endpoints currently have automated fallback coverage (model variant / region / degraded-mode), estimate the monthly burn delta when fallbacks trigger, and surface low-coverage hotspots for an ops/eng pairing this week. Not a formal capacity plan — lightweight triage sheet for immediate mitigations.

Notes to reviewer:
- This is based on telemetry pulled from the fallback-tracker (ad-hoc export) and the billing report for May 2027. Numbers are rough (rounded to nearest 5%).
- 'Burn delta' = estimated additional $/1000 tokens when fallback happens (model downgrade cost difference + expected retry overhead).
- Status: draft — please comment inline or add rows; we'll freeze for handoff on Mon 2027-06-21.

Quick table (rows = endpoints / logical routes):
Columns: endpoint | region | primary-model | fallback-model | fallback-mode | last-fallback | estimated-monthly-fallback-events | est-burn-delta-per-event | monthly-burn-impact | coverage-note | owner | action-needed | ETA
api/chat/v1/generate | us-west1 | rw-large-2q | rw-medium-2q | auto-variant-fallback | 2027-06-14 | 1,200 | $0.12 | $144 | autoscaling surge only; no cache-friendly prefix | Priya Nair | add per-route KV-cache whitelist & spike cap | 2027-06-23
api/embeddings/v1/encode | europe-west1 | embed-xl | embed-sm | regional-fallback | 2027-06-05 | 420 | $0.06 | $25 | fallback incurs 2x latency, downstream retries seen | Liam O'Connor | add latency SLO alert & gradual backoff | 2027-06-24
api/chat/v1/stream | asia-east1 | rw-large-2q | rw-small-2q | degrade-to-batched | 2027-06-12 | 730 | $0.09 | $66 | streaming not supported in fallback model, client-side reconnects | Marta Kim | client sdk patch to show transient degrade msg | 2027-06-25
api/rerank/v1 | us-east1 | rerank-pro | rerank-lite | fallback-model | 2027-06-10 | 60 | $0.30 | $18 | small volume but high per-call delta | Eng: serving-runtime | consider reserving capacity for rerank critical customers | 2027-07-01
api/generate/bulk | global | rw-xlarge | rw-medium-2q | queue-and-throttle | 2027-05-28 | 3,400 | $0.08 | $272 | bursty batch jobs cause queueing; fallback spikes when queue saturates | Product-ops | temp burst quota for top 5 customers; backfill autoscale rules | 2027-06-22
api/embeddings/streaming | us-west2 | embed-xl | embed-sm | no-fallback | N/A | 0 | $0.00 | $0 | explicitly no-fallback configured; risk for high qps | Platform-eng | evaluate safe fallback option (latency-first) | 2027-06-30

Quick observations (raw):
- High-impact items (monthly burn impact > $200): bulk generate route (+$272) and chat generate us-west (+$144). Those two alone ~ $416/month if fallbacks continue at current rate.
- Many fallbacks are due to queue saturation or region-level capacity shortfalls rather than model incompatibility. That suggests policy-level mitigations (burst quotas, smarter routing) will reduce burn more than upgrading models.
- Several streaming routes either degrade to batched or cause client retries — this increases token counts and hidden billing.
- A few low-volume, high-delta endpoints (rerank) are noisy on cost per-event; consider special handling for these critical customers.

Actions / playbook (short):
- (Immediate) Add per-route spike cap for chat generate (owner: Priya). Enforce via routing layer to early-reject / return 429 when client exceeds per-minute soft cap. ETA 2027-06-23.
- (Immediate) Create latency SLO alert for embeddings europe route and set auto-backoff policy in proxy. (owner: Liam). ETA 2027-06-24.
- (Near) Client SDK: surfaced degrade message + exponential reconnect jitter for streaming routes to avoid retries loop. (owner: Marta). ETA 2027-06-25.
- (Near) Temporary reserved burst capacity for top customers on bulk generate (product-ops + solutions-eng). Reduce fallbacks during peak processing windows. ETA 2027-06-22.
- (Investigate) Rerank per-call pricing and possibility to route heavy rerank requests to a dedicated pool. (owner: serving-runtime). Investigation note ticket: RED-412. ETA 2027-07-01.

Open questions / risks (notes for leadership):
- Are we comfortable with temporary quota-reductions for unknown PLG customers in burst windows? Risk: developer friction.
- Hidden billing: clientRetries x tokenCost often not accounted for in alerting; need to add tokenized-cost per-request to error budget dashboards.
- Fallback correctness: some fallbacks change response shape (e.g., streaming -> batched) — product should review critical contract compat.

Scratch area / quick calculations: 
- Example calc (bulk generate): 3,400 events/month * 1,000 tokens avg * $0.08 per 1k tokens = $272
- Streaming retry multiplier estimate: observed 1.8x token traffic during last two incidents on us-west1 (logs: incident-2027-06-12).

Links / references:
- Linear: RED-412 (fallback coverage gaps)
- PR: runtime/pull/985 (dynamic-spike-caps prototype)
- Billing CSV (May-2027 export): /shared_drives/billing/exports/may-2027-billing.csv (internal link)
- Slack: #prod-ops thread 'fallback-spraymap-2027-06-14' for raw telemetry snippets

Next steps for this doc:
- Review with on-call (SRE) + product-ops pairing on Mon 2027-06-21 10:30am PT (30m).
- Freeze the sheet after that meeting, convert to a short runbook (if agreed) and create follow-up Linear tickets for implementation items.

Raw notes / junk (keep for audit):
- pulled fallback counts from ad-hoc query: SELECT route, region, count(*) FROM fallback_log WHERE month='2027-05' GROUP BY 1,2; used sampling window 05/01-05/31
- billing unit assumptions: 1k-token unit pricing from hosted-api plan (internal pricing v3.4)
- toggles used: 'allow-degrade-to-batched' and 'enable-regional-fallback' — both are config flags on routing-service
